content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"no","applies_why":"The judge does not ground UNDERDETERMINED on a single verse's failure to state a link or contrary; it grounds it on the defender's recorded dropping of the curse limb, leaving no live link to contradict.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
